visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long wavy black hair, wearing a white lace-up crop top and blue jeans, is standing in a living room environment. She holds a red smartphone and looks at it with a cheerful smile, then turns to address the camera directly. The room has soft ambient lighting, a decorative globe, and dark wood bookshelves in the background. (2) She transitions to sitting on a black leather sofa, leaning her chin on her hand with a thoughtful or slightly skeptical expression while wearing Chanel-style earrings. The background features a shelf filled with various books and a Darth Vader mask decoration, indicating a personalized domestic space. (3) The scene shifts to a bright kitchen area where she is carrying a large pile of folded white bed sheets and pillowcases. She looks towards someone off-camera, engaging in a dialogue about her meticulous cleaning routine and 'face OCD'. The lighting is bright and even across the space. (4) A close-up sequence in a bathroom shows her wearing a pink fuzzy headband with a cartoon character. She pumps out a thick white foam from a product bottle and applies it generously to her cheeks and forehead, massaging it in with her fingers. (5) She holds up the product bottle labeled SHIMBI METHOD, clearly displaying the brand to the camera. She demonstrates the dense, marshmallow-like texture of the foam by holding a dollop upside down on her palm, showing it does not fall off. (6) Finally, she rinses her face and displays her clean, glowing skin without makeup. She smiles confidently, touching her cheeks to show the smoothness. The video ends with her holding the product next to her face against a plain background with promotional text.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with high-tempo, bouncy electronic background music featuring a light synth melody and a steady drum beat. A young woman speaks in a high-pitched, energetic tone with very clear articulation. The sound of a soft digital click occurs as she interacts with her phone onscreen. (2) A brief transitional 'whoosh' sound effect marks a scene change. Her voice remains friendly and animated as she describes her daily routine. There is no significant ambient noise, suggesting a quiet indoor recording environment with professional post-production audio leveling to ensure the vocal is the primary focus. (3) The sound of water running and splashing into a basin is audible as the scene shifts to a bathroom. Her narration continues over the texture of the water, explaining her skincare process. The vocal quality is crisp, typical of a well-produced social media product review or lifestyle vlog. (4) A distinct mechanical click sound is heard as she pumps the foam dispenser. This is followed by the soft, squelching sound of dense foam being massaged onto the skin. The BGM rhythm stays consistent, providing a cheerful and lighthearted atmosphere throughout the product demonstration. (5) The narration reaches a concluding persuasive tone, becoming more authoritative as she mentions the brand name and the retail availability at POYA. The BGM swells slightly towards the end before a final hard cut to silence as the video concludes.
